name: Updated Provider Profile Link
description: New provider profile team want to provide a new feed into DSI for providing organisation data that should fix the current issues with Provider Profile today.

name: .NET migration
description: Continue with the adoption of .NET as our programming language of choice for DSI services and components, leveraging its performance, scalability, and robust framework.

name: Use of .NET 10
description: Evaluate the adoption of .NET 10 for our DSI services to take advantage of the latest features, performance improvements, and long-term support offered by this version. This is inclusive of assessing compatibility with existing codebases and libraries and also trialing out the concept of file based applications/scripts that can be written in .NET over other scripting languages.

name: Decommission Node JS components
description: As part of our technology consolidation efforts, we plan to decommission Node.js components in favor of more .NET within our stack. This is to be done gradually to ensure stability and not to disrupt live service.

name: Full Entra Integration
description: This would result in our hybrid identity solution with the bespoke OIDC component being replaced by DSI utilsing just Entra to handle all authentication responsibilities.

name: Decommission OIDC component
description: As part of the Full Entra integration, we plan to decommission our bespoke OIDC component, simplifying our authentication architecture and reducing maintenance overhead.

name: Use FaUAPI for exposing the DSI Public API
description: To align to DfE strategy regarding where APIs are exposed from, we will be moving the DSI Public API to be exposed via FaUAPI.

name: Hosting migration to UK south
description: Migrate our hosting infrastructure to the UK South Azure region to improve latency, forgo any capacity limitations and align to wider DfE aspirations for DfE services to be hosted within Azure UK South

name: Change of container hosting service
description: Evaluate and potentially switch to a different Azure container hosting service to improve performance, scalability, and cost-efficiency of our containerized applications.

name: Database consolidation
description: Consolidate the multiple database instances that we currently have into a single, more manageable database instance to reduce complexity, improve performance, and lower Azure costs.

name: Adopt Azure App configuration
description: Implement Azure App Configuration to manage application settings and feature flags centrally, enhancing configuration management and deployment processes.

name: Pipeline improvements
description: Evaluate current CI/CD pipelines and identify areas for improvement to enhance deployment speed, reliability, and automation. This is to ensure smoother releases and better integration practices as we are moving to .NET.

name: DSI data model improvements
description: Review and enhance the DSI data model to improve data integrity, performance, and scalability, ensuring it meets current and future business needs.

name: Release process improvements
description: Analyze the current release process and implement improvements to streamline workflows, reduce errors, and accelerate time-to-market for new features and updates.

name: Public API design and endpoint improvements
description: Identify and implement enhancements to the Public API to improve performance, usability, and developer experience. This is inclusive of new endpoints such as select organisation and the API being rewritten in .NET

name: Adopt blue/green deployment model
description: Evaluate the adoption of a blue/green deployment strategy to minimize downtime and reduce risk during releases.

name: Deprecate SAML Proxies
description: Plan to phase out SAML proxies in favor of more modern authentication methods, improving security and simplifying the authentication architecture. Currently is our weakest point in the platform from a security perspective.

name: Create integration tests
description: Develop comprehensive integration tests to ensure that different components of the DSI system work together seamlessly, enhancing overall system reliability.

name: Chaos engineering
description: Explore the implementation of chaos engineering practices to proactively identify and address potential system weaknesses, improving resilience and fault tolerance.

name: Updated process regarding combined security scans
description: Implement an updated process for conducting combined security scans to enhance vulnerability detection and ensure comprehensive security coverage across all DSI components.
